subject: Anomalies after upgrade to 2.90 and 0.83 and plyr

messages.author: 3b0940ce7a895cd1
messages.subject: Anomalies after upgrade to 2.90 and 0.83 and plyr
parts:
Anomalies are:

1) ggplot does not recognize variables that are in df (ebv2), even though df specified in earlier step
2) A new  "casting formula contains variables not found in molten data" error

Error occurs with both 0.1.6 and 0.1.8 (from git).

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: Anomalies after upgrade to 2.90 and 0.83 and plyr
parts:
>> ggplot(data=ebv2)+geom_point(x=nadler_bv, y=nhratio,
>> shape=",")+facet_grid(sex ~ .)
> Error in do.call("layer", list(mapping = mapping, data = data, stat = stat,
> :
>   object 'nadler_bv' not found
>
> [expected it to find variable]

This should be

+ geom_point(aes(x=nadler_bv, y=nhratio), shape = ",")

because variable names should always go in the aesthetic mapping.
